paragraphs.text: translated by
1. Burn him not up, nor quite consume him, Agni: let not his body or his skin be scattered.
paragraphs.original: मैनमग्ने वि दहो माभि शोचो मास्य त्वचं चिक्षिपो मा शरीरम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mainamagne vi daho mābhi śoco māsya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram |

paragraphs.text: O Jatavedas, when thou hast matured him, then send him on his way unto the Fathers.
paragraphs.original: यदा शृतं कृणवो जातवेदोऽथेमेनं प्र हिणुतात्पितृभ्यः
paragraphs.translit: yadā śṛtaṃ kṛṇavo jātavedo'themenaṃ pra hiṇutātpitṛbhyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. When thou hast made him ready, Jatavedas, then do thou give him over to the Fathers.
paragraphs.original: शृतं यदा करसि जातवेदोऽथेमेनं परि दत्तात्पितृभ्यः ।
paragraphs.translit: śṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedo'themenaṃ pari dattātpitṛbhyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: When he attains unto the life that waits him, he shall become the Deities' controller.
paragraphs.original: यदा गच्छात्यसुनीतिमेतामथा देवानां वशनीर्भवाति
paragraphs.translit: yadā gacchātyasunītimetāmathā devānāṃ vaśanīrbhavāti

paragraphs.text: 3. The Sun receive thine eye, the Wind thy spirit; go, as thy merit is, to earth or heaven.
paragraphs.original: सूर्यं चक्षुर्गच्छतु वातमात्मा द्यां च गच्छ पृथिवीं च धर्मणा ।
paragraphs.translit: sūryaṃ cakṣurgacchatu vātamātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā |

paragraphs.text: Go, if it be thy lot, unto the waters; go, make thine home in plants with all thy members.
paragraphs.original: अपो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रति तिष्ठा शरीरैः
paragraphs.translit: apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Thy portion is the goat: with heat consume him: let thy fierce flame, thy glowing splendour, burn him
paragraphs.original: अजो भागस्तपसा तं तपस्व तं ते शोचिस्तपतु तं ते अर्चिः ।
paragraphs.translit: ajo bhāgastapasā taṃ tapasva taṃ te śocistapatu taṃ te arciḥ |

paragraphs.text: With thine auspicious forms, o Jatavedas, bear this man to the region of the pious.
paragraphs.original: यास्ते शिवास्तन्वो जातवेदस्ताभिर्वहैनं सुकृतामु लोकम्
paragraphs.translit: yāste śivāstanvo jātavedastābhirvahainaṃ sukṛtāmu lokam

paragraphs.text: 5. Again, O Agni, to the Fathers send him who, offered in thee, goes with our oblations.
paragraphs.original: अव सृज पुनरग्ने पितृभ्यो यस्त आहुतश्चरति स्वधाभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: ava sṛja punaragne pitṛbhyo yasta āhutaścarati svadhābhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Wearing new life let him increase his offspring: let him rejoin a body, Jatavedas.
paragraphs.original: आयुर्वसान उप वेतु शेषः सं गच्छतां तन्वा जातवेदः
paragraphs.translit: āyurvasāna upa vetu śeṣaḥ saṃ gacchatāṃ tanvā jātavedaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. What wound soe'er the dark bird hath inflicted, the emmet, or the serpent, or the jackal,
paragraphs.original: यत्ते कृष्णः शकुन आतुतोद पिपीलः सर्प उत वा श्वापदः ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May Agni who devoureth all things heal it and Soma who hath passed into the Brahmans.
paragraphs.original: अग्निष्टद्विश्वादगदं कृणोतु सोमश्च यो ब्राह्मणाँ आविवेश
paragraphs.translit: agniṣṭadviśvādagadaṃ kṛṇotu somaśca yo brāhmaṇām̐ āviveśa

paragraphs.text: 7. Shield thee with flesh against the flames of Agni, encompass thee about with fat and marrow,
paragraphs.original: अग्नेर्वर्म परि गोभिर्व्ययस्व सं प्रोर्णुष्व पीवसा मेदसा च ।
paragraphs.translit: agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva saṃ prorṇuṣva pīvasā medasā ca |

paragraphs.text: So will the Bold One, eager to attack thee with fierce glow fail to girdle and consume thee.
paragraphs.original: नेत्त्वा धृष्णुर्हरसा जर्हृषाणो दधृग्विधक्ष्यन्पर्यङ्खयाते
paragraphs.translit: nettvā dhṛṣṇurharasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhṛgvidhakṣyanparyaṅkhayāte

paragraphs.text: 8. Forbear, O Agni, to upset this ladle: the Gods and they who merit Soma love it.
paragraphs.original: इममग्ने चमसं मा वि जिह्वरः प्रियो देवानामुत सोम्यानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: imamagne camasaṃ mā vi jihvaraḥ priyo devānāmuta somyānām |

paragraphs.text: This ladle, this which serves the Gods to drink from, in this the Immortal Deities rejoice them.
paragraphs.original: एष यश्चमसो देवपानस्तस्मिन्देवा अमृता मादयन्ते
paragraphs.translit: eṣa yaścamaso devapānastasmindevā amṛtā mādayante

paragraphs.text: 9. 1 send afar flesh eating Agni, bearing off stains may he depart to Yama's subjects.
paragraphs.original: क्रव्यादमग्निं प्र हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्ञो गच्छतु रिप्रवाहः ।
paragraphs.translit: kravyādamagniṃ pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājño gacchatu ripravāhaḥ |

paragraphs.text: But let this other Jatavedas carry oblation to the Gods, for he is skillful.
paragraphs.original: इहैवायमितरो जातवेदा देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन्
paragraphs.translit: ihaivāyamitaro jātavedā devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan

paragraphs.text: 10. I choose as God for Father-worship Agni, flesh-eater, who hath past within your dwelling,
paragraphs.original: यो अग्निः क्रव्यात्प्रविवेश वो गृहमिमं पश्यन्नितरं जातवेदसम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yo agniḥ kravyātpraviveśa vo gṛhamimaṃ paśyannitaraṃ jātavedasam |

paragraphs.text: While looking on this other Jatavedas. Let him light flames in the supreme assembly.
paragraphs.original: तं हरामि पितृयज्ञाय देवं स घर्ममिन्वात्परमे सधस्थे
paragraphs.translit: taṃ harāmi pitṛyajñāya devaṃ sa gharmaminvātparame sadhasthe

paragraphs.text: 11. With offerings meet let Agni bring the Fathers who support the Law.
paragraphs.original: यो अग्निः क्रव्यवाहनः पितॄन्यक्षदृतावृधः ।
paragraphs.translit: yo agniḥ kravyavāhanaḥ pitṝnyakṣadṛtāvṛdhaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let him announce oblations paid to Fathers and to Deities.
paragraphs.original: प्रेदु हव्यानि वोचति देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्य आ
paragraphs.translit: predu havyāni vocati devebhyaśca pitṛbhya ā

paragraphs.text: 12. Right gladly would we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow.
paragraphs.original: उशन्तस्त्वा नि धीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि ।
paragraphs.translit: uśantastvā ni dhīmahyuśantaḥ samidhīmahi |

paragraphs.text: Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to cat the food of sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: उशन्नुशत आ वह पितॄन्हविषे अत्तवे
paragraphs.translit: uśannuśata ā vaha pitṝnhaviṣe attave

paragraphs.text: 13. Cool, Agni, and again refresh the spot which thou hast scorched and burnt.
paragraphs.original: यं त्वमग्ने समदहस्तमु निर्वापया पुनः ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ tvamagne samadahastamu nirvāpayā punaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Here let the water-lily grow, and tender grass and leafy herb.
paragraphs.original: कियाम्ब्वत्र रोहतु पाकदूर्वा व्यल्कशा
paragraphs.translit: kiyāmbvatra rohatu pākadūrvā vyalkaśā

paragraphs.text: 14. O full of coolness, thou cool Plant, full of fresh moisture, freshening Herb,
paragraphs.original: शीतिके शीतिकावति ह्लादिके ह्लादिकावति ।
paragraphs.translit: śītike śītikāvati hlādike hlādikāvati |

paragraphs.text: Come hither with the female frog: fill with delight this Agni here.
paragraphs.original: मण्डूक्या सु सं गम इमं स्वग्निं हर्षय
paragraphs.translit: maṇḍūkyā su saṃ gama imaṃ svagniṃ harṣaya
